params.caption:
🏆 The Game Awards 2026 nominees are here — and GTA VI leads the pack!

The Game Awards 2026 nominees were revealed, voted by a global jury of 160+ media outlets.

📌 Key facts:
• GTA VI tops the list with 8 nominations, including Game of the Year
• CONTROL Resonant and Resident Evil Requiem each picked up 6 nominations
• Phantom Blade Zero follows close behind with 5
• Game of the Year nominees: 007 First Light, CONTROL Resonant, Grand Theft Auto VI, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem
• The ceremony airs live December 10 from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles; fan voting closes December 9

🕓 Published: 04:03 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Gematsu, The Game Awards (thegameawards.com)

Vote for your pick before Dec 9 and tell us your Game of the Year prediction in the comments!
